subject: Vendor LZ4 1.10.0 (#3531)
reason: The change only vendors the LZ4 1.10.0 sources into deps/lz4/ and adds them to the deps build (deps/Makefile, deps/CMakeLists.txt), plus README, LICENSE, REUSE.toml and typos.toml updates. No file under src/ references LZ4: the server, tools and tests neither compile nor link the new library, and no command, persistence, or replication code path calls into it. It is a build/vendoring-only change with no reachable runtime behaviour difference, so no scenario can exercise it.
